assign.outcome:
**Sixteen notebook spreads (039–054) are pages you can browse — the framework's own design history, linked to what it became.**

![](wall.png)

Each page is the photograph, the full transcription in the owner's words, and a linked list of what the site actually built from it. Four of them sketch a UI, so four are built:

- [An element browser](/notes/an-element-browser/) — the note's four tabs (Elements · Layout · Sections · Components), live; every leaf links to the page where that element is real.
- [Tabs vs breadcrumbs](/notes/tabs-vs-breadcrumbs/) — two frames over one tree, so "BAD = JUMPY UX" is a thing you watch happen: the tab bar replaces every word it shows, the trail only grows.
- [Page previews, & columns](/notes/page-previews-and-columns/) — the note's three card sketches, side by side; they differ only in where the picture goes.
- [page ≠ prose](/notes/page-is-not-prose/) — the 3-column grid and its three subdivisions, each linking to where that arrangement does real work.

![](jump.png)

**The other twelve** — [Walk down, or jump to topic?](/notes/walk-down-or-jump-to-topic/) · [Starter repo vs scaffolding?](/notes/starter-repo-vs-scaffolding/) · [Mobile tabs are tricky](/notes/mobile-tabs-are-tricky/) · [OOP course + responsive web design = freedom](/notes/oop-course-equals-freedom/) · [jsDelivr, or your own CDN?](/notes/jsdelivr-or-your-own-cdn/) · [A localhost CDN](/notes/a-localhost-cdn/) · [There are too many patterns to exemplify?](/notes/too-many-patterns-to-exemplify/) · [Build now, architect later](/notes/build-now-architect-later/) · [Forgot to branch (repair)](/notes/forgot-to-branch/) · [Links that don't break](/notes/links-that-dont-break/) · [Straight talk](/notes/straight-talk/) · [Perfectly simple syntax?](/notes/perfectly-simple-syntax/) — describe no UI, so they build none and say so in a line.

**Proof.** 68 page loads (index + 16 notes × 400/1280/1920/3440): zero console errors, zero sideways scroll, every page renders its own title. All 46 internal links navigated, not file-probed — all resolve. Both interactive builds driven headless: pressing a tab swaps its list; clicking `A` replaces `A B C` with `A1 A2 A3` while the trail grows `ROOT › A`. The index wall carries all sixteen cards at 400/1280/3440, 66 photo thumbs, none broken.

**Left, with reasons.**

- **ext/Doc member pages 404 from anywhere** — `/framework/core/Page/doc/method/link/`, `doc/method/crumbs/`, `doc/method/preview_card/`, `doc/method/activate/`, `doc/property/children/`, `/framework/core/App/doc/method/inject/`. The `.md` files exist and are served; only the note routes (`doc/<name>/`) mint. Pre-existing — `core/Page/page.js` already links two of them. Outside my write fence, so I repointed my eleven affected links at routes that verifiably render and left the defect for whoever owns `ext/Doc`.
- **`/framework/styles/doc/*.md` is not routed at all** — those docs live at `/framework/styles/rules/<name>/` and `/framework/styles/layers/<name>/`.
- **`public/notes/readme.md` and `notes.css` untouched** — shared with the other note batches and outside my fence. No new CSS was needed and no class name was minted.
- **Three names removed, each linking its original**: 039 opens with a path carrying the owner's first name, 040 uses it twice as a case-sensitivity example (`Name && name`), 052 names a product with the owner's surname (**the L. Cube**).
